title: Arabam.com Vehicle Scraper
description: Collect structured used vehicle listings from Arabam.com using one URL or a keyword and location. The actor reads Arabam's public search and listing pages directly and enriches each record with its published specifications.

url.title: Arabam.com URL
url.description: One Arabam.com search, category, or listing detail URL. URL filters take priority over keyword and location.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Vehicle, make, or model search text used when a URL is not supplied.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of vehicle records to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Maximum pages to request per search URL.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings. Residential proxies are recommended for Arabam.com.
